name: oxide
description: Root orchestration for local dev: backing services (Postgres/Redis/Prometheus/Grafana), the api process (Axum API + Pingora proxy), the telemetry ETL consumer, and the web/ control panel.

scripts.start: concurrently -n api,telemetry,web -c blue.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold "cargo run -p api" "cargo run -p telemetry" "npm --prefix web run dev"
